boards.name: Manatal
boards.notes: Per-user monthly plans with a 14-day free trial. API endpoints need a token from support. Integrations directory lists job boards and tools. Affiliate program is a referral scheme and is not counted as a partner program. Office listed as Manatal Singapore without a headquarters label.

sources.title: Pricing and plans
sources.quote: Professional Plan For individuals & small teams $15/per user per month

sources.title: Manatal API documentation
sources.quote: To target those endpoints you need to obtain a token from our support team.

sources.title: Homepage job board section
sources.quote: 2,500+ job boards: Global, local and specialized organic and premium platforms integrated natively.

boards.name: Gupy
boards.notes: Brazilian recruiting and HR platform. Pricing page lists plans without prices. Partnership page invites partners and the integrations hub lists certified partner tools. No developer or API page was linked from the header or footer, so no api_status is recorded. Headquarters and parent company are not stated.

sources.title: Planos e precos
sources.quote: Não, nossas soluções estão agrupadas em planos que variam de acordo com as necessidades e o contexto de cada empresa.

sources.title: Programa de parcerias
sources.quote: Amplie seu Impacto e aumente seus resultados! Seja um parceiro Gupy.

boards.name: Paradox
boards.notes: Partners and integrations page links to the developer hub. Developer hub documents an OAuth 2.0 token flow but no page states how to obtain access. No pricing, language options or headquarters found on the site.

boards.name: Fountain
boards.notes: Partner page lists HR tech vendors and integrations. Developer docs say keys are created in the user profile or in integration settings. Pricing, headquarters, parent company and languages are not stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Fountain API documentation, get started
sources.quote: Personal key: Open your Profile > Manage API Keys.

boards.name: Trakstar Hire
boards.notes: Hiring product posts job descriptions to job boards. Pricing page asks for a quote and shows no prices. Header, footer and integrations pages mention no API, developer docs or partner program. Address on the about page is under a Contact Us label, not a headquarters label.

sources.title: Trakstar Hire job posting
sources.quote: Create job descriptions and automatically post them to the top job boards.

boards.name: Concludis
boards.notes: Concludis is a product of Perbility GmbH according to the copyright line on its page. Perbility states Bamberg as headquarters without a country beside the address; its site says Made and Hosted in Germany in a separate line, so hq_country is not recorded. No pricing, API access method or partner program stated.

boards.name: Occy
boards.notes: UK based applicant tracking system for internal hiring teams. Headquarters block on the contact page gives a Milton Keynes address and the page calls the company UK based. Integrations page says hundreds more are available on request. No pricing, API, language options or partner program found.

reviews.name: Gupy

reviews.name: Paradox

reviews.name: Fountain

reviews.name: Trakstar Hire

reviews.note: Homepage, integrations, FAQ and contact pages read; headquarters found on the contact page; no pricing, API or partner program stated.
